purpose: Proves the provenance rule that every non-code asset the entrypoint references must be declared in the artifact's resource_manifest. An asset present on disk and referenced but absent from the manifest fails the oracle (undeclared/unprovenanced resource).
required_evidence: entrypoint source asset references (project-relative, valid paths)
set-difference: referenced-and-present assets NOT listed in manifest
rationale: assets/logo.svg is referenced by the entrypoint and exists on disk but has no resource_manifest entry, so its provenance (origin/hash) is unknown. The provenance rule requires every referenced asset to be declared, so the oracle returns fail.
